subject: ecology

resources.title: USGS Ecosystems Science
resources.notes: USGS research, data, tools, and decision-support material spanning populations, communities, landscapes, ecosystem change, conservation, restoration and ecological modeling. Exact ATLAS taxonomy keys replace legacy guessed labels.

resources.title: USGS Aquatic Ecology Group
resources.notes: USGS states that this research spans freshwater, estuarine and marine environments and includes behavioral, population and community ecology, threatened species, food webs and climate effects.

resources.title: Sustaining Healthy Freshwater Ecosystems
resources.notes: EPA educational reference explains freshwater ecosystem integrity, watershed connections, population and community dynamics, nutrient and chemical inputs, conservation and restoration principles.

resources.title: Principles of Wetland Restoration
resources.notes: EPA restoration guidance covers ecological integrity, watershed context, natural structure/function, nutrient cycles, succession, monitoring and adaptive restoration.

resources.title: EPA Nutrient Management Research
resources.notes: EPA research addresses nitrogen and phosphorus cycling, freshwater and coastal ecosystem responses, recovery, data, models and tools.

known_gaps: dedicated evolutionary ecology curriculum across the full learning ladder
foundation-level marine ecology remains thinner than freshwater ecology
expert readiness still requires books, primary literature, assessment, runtime ingestion and retrieval verification
